newsitem.title: USA: Regal One names Currie as chairman.
newsitem.headline: Regal One names Currie as chairman.

text.p: Regal One Corp has completed the acquisition of Safesight Inc in a stock-for-stock transaction and also named Malcolm Currie as chairman of the board.
Currie is chairman emeritus of Hughes Aircraft and chairman and chief executive of Currie Technologies Inc.
Richard Babbitt has been named as President and Chief Financial Officer. He has served as Chairman of the American Seat Belt Council and the Safety Helmet Council.
Terms and further details were not immediately available.
